results.budget_stopping_legality: 0 invariant violations on 20,972 design campaign records (dev P2 grid, dev P3, gate, eval primary, own fp, wells, pipeline, P3, LOO-125) and 1,750 feedback records (all 7 arms): spent <= cap; no screen in the final round; every verification is an earlier-round revealed screen hit of the same campaign; no re-purchase; round logs consistent with record lists; measurement spend = purchases. Verify's own 1,098 campaigns: 0 violations.
results.leakage_poisoning: verify implementation: 244 E campaigns (R and C_mean at fp 30, R at own fp) with every unpurchased target-line outcome flipped and every other E line randomised -> identical purchases. Design code: 366 E campaigns (R, C_mean, S_both at fp 30) with unpurchased target-line outcomes flipped, the target line's other role assignment randomised and every other E line randomised in both roles -> identical purchases and confirmed counts.
results.condition_identity: builder panels: SV/VS share rows and lines; SV verification call and label equal VS screen call and label and vice versa in all 3 tissues (7,363 / 7,405 / 4,781 rows). Design primary records: all 23,868 revealed screen values and 4,398 revealed verification values equal the builder value of the same line, role and menu row, and every verification equals the other role's screen measurement of the same pair and line.
results.reproducibility: verify in-process rerun identical (digest c540aa62...7831); design code rerun (366 campaigns) identical to its files; across processes the three verify runs agree transitively (first run = design primary = resources two-round records = third run)
results.code_review_notes: design: history views remove E rows before any computation and make_target asserts target and forbidden lines absent; feedback worlds use HD lines plus the target only (world_keep) with an assertion, and the frozen TransferWorld zeroes the target line's own labels in its history (world.py _build_history).
